# Inkdraft

> Inkdraft is an AI tattoo design tool for tattoo artists. It turns a client's brief into four drawn concepts, variations of the chosen one and a clean single-weight stencil ready for Procreate, plus an on-skin preview to show the client. The artist always finishes the tattoo: Inkdraft handles the unpaid part, the idea and the first sketch.

- Website: https://www.inkdraft.tattoo/ (English) · https://www.inkdraft.tattoo/es/ (Spanish)
- Contact: hello@inkdraft.tattoo
- Status: pre-sale. 50 founder seats at €19/month for life. Founders get beta access in early December 2026.

## How it works
1. Brief: describe the client's request (subject, placement, size), optionally with up to 3 reference photos, read as taste and never copied.
2. Concepts: four different concepts, each with its own drawing. The artist picks by eye.
3. Variations: three variations of the chosen concept (close, medium, bold).
4. Stencil: single-weight linework, true to the drawing, at 2048 px, no shading. Opens in Procreate.
5. On skin: upload a photo of the placement, position the design and get a realistic preview for the client.

## Styles
- Blackwork (available): antique engraving linework, creatures fused with objects, solid black anchor.
- In progress: fineline and traditional. Founders can ask for other styles.

## Pricing (EUR, monthly)
- Trial: €0, 3 designs, no card.
- Starter: €19, 10 designs.
- Pro: €39, 30 designs.
- Studio: €99, 100 designs, up to 5 artists.
- Founder seat (pre-sale, 50 seats): Pro plan at €19/month for life.
A design = idea + drawn concept + stencil + on-skin preview.

## Who it's for
Tattoo artists starting out, experienced artists whose drawing time eats their week, and studios with a steady flow of requests.

## Ownership
Artists own what they generate: free to tattoo, post and sell.
